description: Illustrative offline input only, not a customer quote. Replace every path and commercial assumption with dated evidence before use.

node.note: Observed node allocatable resources, not advertised 4 CPU / 8 GB. A 3900m benchmark envelope does not fit this node before other requests.

retention.note: The calculator combines this with observed soak generated_bytes_per_terminal. It does not project a two-hour growth slope indefinitely or assume autovacuum shrinks files.

node.note: DigitalOcean Premium AMD s-4vcpu-8gb-amd price was not verified on the public price page at 2026-10-31; null propagates to node and combined cost.

object_storage.note: No per-request fee was confirmed; retain null rather than inventing a charge.

pricing.kubernetes_control_plane_note: Default control plane is modeled at $0. Set this explicit input to $40 when selecting DigitalOcean Kubernetes HA control plane pricing.

model_provider.note: Keep model-provider spend separate from infrastructure and supply dated unit costs.

notes: Demand is explicit successful workflow/agent-request volume; it is never derived from a saturation rate.
Node billing is Ready-node time, monthly unit price x node count x utilized-month fraction, never pod utilization.
The CLI requires a fresh output directory: python3 scripts/bench/hosting.py --scenario scenario.json --out /new/card.
